> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-28

# Summary
Round 1 of improving not-indexed posts, live Sep 28, 2026 14:03 UTC (`CHANGES.md`). Scope: the 4 not-indexed posts with 0 paid impressions in 90 days and no hold.

# Key findings
- 13726 /when-is-pipe-descaling-necessary/ (pipe descaling): 3,223 to 1,349 words; filler cut, question H2s, symptom table, City of Phoenix hard-water citation, 4-question FAQ and schema.
- 13682 /understanding-pipe-restoration-repiping-vs-pipelining/ (repiping vs relining): rebuilt as a real comparison with a table and FAQ; 0 "pipelining" nouns.
- 13694 /how-much-does-trenchless-pipe-lining-cost/: 539 to 838 words; cost-factor list, lining vs digging (20 to 30%), FAQ. Price, warranty and lifespan figures left as they were (Scott to confirm).
- 13712 /top-10-signs-your-home-needs-pipe-restoration/ (Elementor): 4,135 to 1,607 words; generic maintenance section cut; FAQ schema 10 to 4 questions.
- Skipped: both myths posts (ads and Kim hold), the residential guide (merge held), /pipelining/ and /pipeline-locating/ (ad-touched), leak detection (already rewritten).

# Decisions and status
- Titles, H1s, metas and slugs unchanged. New inbound links added from ad-free indexed posts. Verified on desktop and Googlebot mobile.
- Undo: post meta `_pl_backup_ni_20260928`. GSC Request Indexing done for all 5 including leak detection.
- Open: junk OTTO twitter:title on 13712 not changed.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `CHANGES.md`, before/after HTML and JSON, PHP and Python scripts.
